description: This file defines the RegisterModel class for the user registration page in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application, handling user registration, email confirmation, and sign-in processes.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: Model class for the user registration page, handling registration logic, user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, sets the return URL for redirection after registration.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user registration, creating a new user, sending confirmation email, and signing in.
